nl_spec: Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: output swing of at least 1.12 V; CMRR at low frequency of at least 42 dB; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 410 nV/sqrt(Hz).

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: CMRR at low frequency of at least 50 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 47 uW; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 40 dB; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 210 nV/sqrt(Hz).

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 39 uW; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 43 dB; output swing of at least 1.5 V; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 190 nV/sqrt(Hz); DC gain of at least 45 dB; CMRR at low frequency of at least 51 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 5.8 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 67 dB; slew rate of at least 17 MV/s; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 260 nV/sqrt(Hz); unity-gain bandwidth of at least 26 MHz; CMRR at low frequency of at least 50 dB; DC gain of at least 75 dB; phase margin of at least 66 degrees; output swing of at least 1.52 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 380 uW; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 32 ns.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: unity-gain bandwidth of at least 20 MHz; phase margin of at least 53 degrees; output swing of at least 1.05 V; DC gain of at least 65 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.1 mW. All requirements must hold across process corners (tt, ff, ss, sf, fs), temperatures -40/27/125 C and supply 1.62-1.98 V.
